reasoning_content: Let's check the actual lines around the port in order to understand the service name structure.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "cd /workspace
for port in 18005 18007 18008; do
  line=$(grep -n "\-\-port $port " process-compose.yaml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
  echo "=== port $port @ line $line ==="
  awk -v l="$line" 'NR<=l && /name:/ {n=$0; nl=NR} END{print "last name before line l:", n, "@", nl}' process-compose.yaml
done
echo "--- show context 18005 ---"
sed -n '175,200p' process-compose.yaml", "description": "Map ports to service names with context", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Show port-to-service mapping context"}
